Actor:
You gain +1 Perform, and gain +2 more Perform when impersonating someone/something else.

Upgrade: +5 more Perform when impersonating.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls when using Perform to impersonate.
Attention To Detail:
You gain +3 Detection.

Upgrade: +6 Detection.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls on any Detection check.
Charger: If you make no Attacks this turn, you may move into occupied spaces, pushing objects/enemies into adjacent spaces.
Chug: Drinking a liquid (no more than a quart) takes 1 Action instead of 4.
Concentration: You gain +2 Will. While using an ability that requires concentration, you gain +2 Move Actions.
Dodge: You gain +2 Reflex. If you successfully dodge an attack with Reflex, you may shift 1 space. This can happen anytime.
Dual-Wield Finesse: Requires 7 FA. While wielding 2 Finesse weapons, you may use them both in the same attack. The Actions required for this attack are from whichever weapon is slower. A separate attack roll must be made for each weapon, unless they are the same weapon - then a singular roll can count for both attacks.
Dual-Wield Heavy: Requires 7 HA. While wielding 2 Heavy weapons, you may use them both in the same attack. The Actions required for this attack are from whichever weapon is slower. A separate attack roll must be made for each weapon, unless they are the same weapon - then a singular roll can count for both attacks.
Dual-Wield Light: Requires 7 LA. While wielding 2 Light weapons, you may use them both in the same attack. The Actions required for this attack are from whichever weapon is slower. A separate attack roll must be made for each weapon, unless they are the same weapon - then a singular roll can count for both attacks.
Dungeon Delver: You take half damage from all traps. You also gain +3 Detection when specifically detecting traps.
Favored Enemy:
Passive. Choose a Race to be a Favored Enemy. You gain +4 to all Defenses, Attacks, and Damage when battling this enemy.

Aberrations/Demons.
Dragons/Sahuagin.
Giants/Trolls.
Orcs/Ogres.
Fleet-footed: You gain +2 Move actions each turn.
Innovation: You may take the higher of 2d20 Intelligence rolls once per day.
Keen Mind: You gain +1 Survival and can always tell direction, time of day, and details of anything you’ve experienced in the past month.
Large Hands: You treat all 2-handed weapons like 1-handed weapons. However, all 2H weapons each now cause -2 to all attacks, spells, and damage.
Lightning Reflexes: You may add your Acrobatics skill to Initiative rolls.
Mage Slayer: If someone adjacent to you casts a spell, you may instantly make a Basic Attack against them. This does not take up any actions on your turn.
Martial Arts:
You deal an extra 2d damage with your Unarmed attacks.

Upgrade: An extra 4d damage.
Narcoleptic: You must take a nap every few hours, but receive the benefit of a long rest each time.
Pacifist: Passive. If you have gone at least 24 hours without making any Attack actions, you may take the higher of 2d20 rolls for all your skills and abilities. Lasts until the moment you make an Attack action.
Parry:
You gain +4 Fortitude for each melee weapon you currently wield. Shields do not count as weapons.

Upgrade: You also gain +2 Reflex for each weapon.
Physician:
You gain +3 Medicine.

Upgrade: You gain +6 Medicine.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2 rolls when using a Medikit, and can use it as often as you'd like in battle.
Point-Blank: If you use a Ranged attack on an adjacent target, you deal the maximum damage of that attack. You must already meet the weapon's Ranged Attack requirement.
Sidestep:
Making an Attack gives you 1 extra Move action. This can only happen once per turn.

Upgrade: Gives you 3 extra Move actions.
Steely Surgeon:
Passive. You may use Medikits on yourself.

Upgrade: Medikits cost -2 actions to use.
Sniper: If you use a Ranged weapon to attack a target at least 20 spaces away, you gain +7 Ranged Attack. You must already meet the weapon's Ranged Attack requirement.
Tough: You may add your level to your Total HP.
Cave Dweller: Passive. You have naturally tough skin, gaining +1 Armor, and you can see with almost no light.
Earthcunning:
Passive. You gain +5 to all Intelligence-based rolls when dealing with stone.

Upgrade: You gain the same benefit when dealing with metals.
Hardy: Passive. To you, all armor has 1 less of a Fortitude requirement.
Mason:
Passive. You gain +3 to a Crafting skill of your choice:
Armor/Clothes
Food/Beverages
Weapons/Tools

Upgrade: +6 to your chosen Crafting skill.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls when using your chosen Crafting skill.
Mountaineer: Passive. You gain +1 to all d20 rolls while in a hill or mountain terrain.
Resilience: Passive. You are immune to penalties from hot climates, and poison deals 1 less damage against you each turn.
Immortal: Passive. You cannot die of old age. Also, you may roll for Will instead of Fortitude against poisons and disease.
Fey Ancestry: Passive. You may take the higher of 2d20 Will rolls against Charms and Sleep spells/poisons.
Trance: Passive. Instead of 8 hours of sleep, you only require 4 hours of a semiconscious meditative state.
Combat Training: Passive. You gain +1 to all Dexterity skills.
Woodswalker: Passive. You permanently gain +1 Move action. You are not hindered in obscure weather like mist, snow, or heavy rain.
Elven Weapons: Passive. You gain +3 Light Attack when wielding swords or bows.
Subtle Charm: Passive. Once a day, you can take the higher of 2d20 rolls for any Charisma-based skill.
Keen Senses: Passive. You gain +3 to Detection. When investigating, you spend half the actions as normal.
Stealth Dilettante: Passive. You add 1d8 damage to all attacks done while in Stealth. Attack vs Fortitude.
Proficiency: Passive. You may add up to 2 of your Arcana as accuracy for physical attacks.
Profound Luck: Passive. Once per day, you may take the higher of 2d20 rolls for any Dexterity-based skill.
Bravery: Passive. You gain +5 Will against Haunt and Intimidate attacks.
Creature of Comfort:
Passive. You gain +3 to Crafting Food/Beverages.

Upgrade: +6 to Crafting Food/Beverages.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls for Crafting Food/Beverages.
Nimble: Passive. You do not need to roll for Acrobatics when moving through a space that is occupied by someone larger than you.
Storyteller:
Passive. You gain +3 Perform.

Upgrade: +6 Perform.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 Perform rolls.
Unnoticed:
Passive. You gain +3 Stealth and Deception when avoiding hunters and lawkeepers.

Upgrade: +6 Stealth and Deception.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls for Stealth and Deception when avoiding hunters and lawkeepers.
Wings:
Passive. You have wings that allow you to fly 1 space per Move action.

Upgrade: 2 spaces per Move action.

Upgrade: 3 spaces per Move action.
Elemental Breath:
6 actions. You let out a roar, unleashing the elements on everyone in a 1x5 cone from you. Finesse Attack vs Fortitude.
You must choose:

Acid Breath: All enemies lose 1 (+ 1/2 your Level) Armor. Your scales are black.

Fire Breath: 1d12 (+ Your Level) damage, 1/3 chance ignition. Your scales are crimson.

Frost Breath: 1d4 (+ Your Level) damage, and all targets lose 2 actions on their next turn. Your scales are sapphire.

Lightning Breath: 1d10 (+ Your Level) damage, doubled to any targets with 7+ Armor. Your scales are golden.

Poison Breath: All enemies are poisoned, taking 1d4 damage each turn. Your scales are emerald.

Sonic Roar: 1d4 (+ Your Level) damage, bypassing Armor. Your scales are diamond.
Draconic Resistance: Passive. You are immune to an elemental effect, depending on your chosen elemental breath. See your GM for details.
Forceful Roar: Passive. Any successful use of your Elemental Breath will also knock your target on their back. They must take 3 actions to pick themselves up again. Finesse Attack vs. Fortitude.
Lung Capacity:
Passive. You may use your Elemental Breath ability 2x per battle.

Upgrade: 3x per battle.
Easy Marks: Passive. You gain +1 Armor and damage when battling Large-size or larger enemies.
Adaptable: Passive. You may use your Survival skill in place of your Will against magical attacks.
Entreprenuer:
Passive. You gain +1 to all Crafting skills and +2 Persuasion when buying/selling.

Upgrade: +2 Crafting, +4 Persuasion.

Upgrade: +3 Crafting, +6 Persuasion.
Tinkerer:
Passive. You gain +3 to all Hardware skills when dealing with electronic devices.

Upgrade: +6 Hardware.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 Hardware rolls.
Escapist: Passive. While next to an object or person at least 3 ft tall, you may take the higher of 2d20 Stealth rolls. Stealth vs Detection.
Agile: Passive. As long as your Armor is no more than 7, you may Climb a number of spaces up to half your Acrobatics roll.
Cunning: Passive. You no longer break lockpicking tools or trigger password failsafes.
Fury: Passive. While attacking a Medium or larger creature, you may choose to add your Level to the damage. You can use this once per day.
Tamer:
Passive. You gain +3 Animal Handling.

Upgrade: +6 Animal Handling.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 Animal Handling rolls.
Large: Passive. You are a size Large, and all effects against you act accordingly.
Athlete:
Passive. You gain +3 Athletics.

Upgrade: +6 Athletics.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls when using Athletics.
Fair Play: 4 actions. Choose an enemy within 5 spaces. That enemy receives +3 to all their Attack skills. At the same time, you receive +6 to all Charisma skills. Lasts 5 turns. Persuasion vs Will.
Mountain Born: Passive. You gain extra Fortitude against cold attacks equal to your Level. Cold climates don't affect you, short of a blizzard.
Stone's Endurance: Reaction. When you are attacked, you may choose to use 2 of your next turn's actions to reduce the damage dealt to you by 1d12. You can use this once per day.
Survival Of The Fittest: Passive. Upon watching someone die, be it by your own hand or another's, you gain +2 Will for 3 turns. This effect stacks.
Savagery: Passive. Once per battle, you may take the higher of 2 Damage rolls.
Menacing:
Passive. You gain +4 Intimidation and Aggression.

Upgrade: +8 Intimidation and Aggression.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls for Intimidate and Aggression.
Night Hunter: Passive. You can see in the dark up to 12 spaces, and have an excellent sense of smell.
Pack Leader:
Passive. You gain +2 Total HP for every member in your party besides yourself.

Upgrade: +4 Total HP.
Relentless: Reaction. An attack that would bring your HP to 0 brings it to 1 instead. On your next turn, your Armor is 0, no matter what you're wearing. Only usable once per day.
Tribal:
Passive. You gain +3 Survival and Culture in lesser-advanced communities.

Upgrade: +6 Survival and Culture.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls for Survival and Culture.
Agility:
1 action. You activate your feline senses. You may now move 2 spaces for every Move action. Lasts 5 turns. Acrobatics.

Upgrade: 3 spaces for every Move action.
Infernal: Passive. You take half damage from fire and cannot be ignited.
Alacrity: Passive: All spells cost -1 action to cast, down to a minimum action cost of 1.
Blood Link:
24 actions. You link yourself to a willing ally. For 1 action, you or that ally may transfer up to 1d10 HP between each other. This cannot bring one of you to 0 HP. Only usable once per day. Link lasts until a new link is made.

Upgrade: Up to 2d10 HP.

Upgrade: Up to 3d10 HP.
Devil's Tongue:
Passive. You permanently gain +3 to a Charisma skill of your choice.

Upgrade: +6 to the same Charisma skill.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls for that skill.
Outcast:
Passive. You gain +2 Culture and Insight.

Upgrade: You gain +4 Culture and Insight.
Wanton: Passive. You permanently have +1 action each turn.
Shell: Passive. While you are not wearing any armor, your Armor counts as half your Level (rounded up).
Inorganic: Passive. You do not require food, drink, or oxygen, and are immune to disease and bleeding. Being exposed to water stuns you, however, and you cannot swim, no matter your Acrobatics roll. Medikits are ineffective on you, though you can be "repaired" with a 10-action 1d6 Hardware: Machinery roll.
Compartmentalize: Passive. You have compartments within your body for extra storage. The amount of non-wielded weapons/armor items you can carry is now (Athletics + 6).
Detached: Passive. You suffer no damage from losing arms or legs, and can detach them easily yourself.
Sentry: Passive. Though you still require 6 hours of inert recharging each day, you now remain alert and aware of your surroundings during this time.
Technolink:
Passive. Once per day, you may take the higher of 2d20 rolls for any of these skills:
Hardware - Machinery
Hardware - Vehicles
Hardware - Weaponry
Software
Waterproof: Passive. You no longer short out when submerged in water, and can swim a number of spaces up to 1/4 of your Acrobatics roll, rounded up. You lose this bonus if any limbs are detached.
Barter:
Passive. You gain +3 Persuasion when buying/selling.

Upgrade: +6 Persuasion.

Passive. You gain +3 Ranged Attack while using weapons other than firearms.

Heavyweight: Passive. You are treated as a size Large when it comes to effects that move you against your will.
Bouncer: You gain +10 Detection vs hidden targets next to you, and +10 Will vs Deception checks against you.
Frontliner:

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 attack rolls.

Stench: Passive. You are inedible, and gain +1 Intimidate against everyone next to you.
Warmonger: Passive. You deal an extra 1d12 damage to all attacks against a target who has used Aggression against you.
Amphibious:
Passive. You may Swim a number of spaces up to half your Acrobatics roll. Also, you may breathe underwater for up to 1 hour.

Mucus: 3 actions. You launch mucus at a target within 5 spaces, blinding them on their next turn. Roll 1d6 - on a 5 or 6, the target also becomes diseased. Ranged Attack vs Reflex.
Tongue: 2 actions. You may grab an object of Small size within 2 spaces and immediately pull it toward you using your tongue.
Scavenger:
Passive. Gain +3 Survival when gathering supplies.

Upgrade: +6 Survival.

Passive. You gain +2 Heavy Attack and +1 Ranged Attack.

Provoked: Passive. This only applies while you are missing HP. If you make a successful melee attack, you may roll 1d6. On a 5 or 6, you disarm your target. Attack vs Fortitude.
Shiriiwook: X actions. When communicating with another Wookie, you may adjust your vocal chords so only they can understand. Even those who have studied your native language cannot interpret this message. Linguistics vs Linguistics.
Short Fuse: Passive. You may choose to make an Aggression roll after any Attack, Move, or Speaking action, free of action costs.
Crown Of Horns: Passive. Successful melee attacks against you deal 1d4 damage (bypassing Armor) to the attacker.
Alien Endurance: Passive. You may reuse a physical ability that you have used this battle. It cannot be a Daily ability. You may use this once per day.
Force Sensitive: Passive. You may take the higher of 2d20 Spirituality rolls once per day.
Self-Sufficient: 4 actions. You heal yourself for 1d4 + your Medicine skill, no Medikit required. If there are no allies within 10 spaces, the die roll is instead 1d10.
